device.user_gone: This Homey user no longer exists.

settings.title: Which users count as "everyone"?
settings.intro: The "everyone" Flow cards look at the users ticked below, live, every time a Flow runs. A new Homey user is counted automatically, so you never have to edit a Flow after someone joins the household. Untick anyone who should not hold the whole house back — a guest account, or a phone that never reports presence. Accounts disabled in Homey are always ignored.
settings.vacation_intro: A user on vacation is left out of the "everyone" cards, so those keep working for whoever is still around. Vacation can also be set from a Flow, or from the user's vacation device.
settings.vacation_auto_return: Clear vacation automatically when someone comes home
settings.one_home_awake: Exactly one at home is awake
settings.log_title: What the app has been doing
settings.log_intro: The most recent events, newest first — triggers that fired, vacation changes and any errors. Kept in memory only, so it is cleared whenever the app restarts and nothing is written to your Homey's storage.
settings.log_persist: Keep the log across app restarts

log.last_asleep: __name__ was the last person at home to fall asleep.
log.last_asleep_any: __name__ is the last person to go to sleep.
log.first_awake: __name__ is the first person at home to wake up.
log.first_home_asleep: __name__ is the first person at home to go to sleep.
log.first_asleep: __name__ is the first person to go to sleep.
log.first_awake_any: __name__ is the first person to wake up.
log.auto_return: __name__ came home while on vacation; clearing their vacation status.
log.persist_on: Log will now be kept across restarts.
log.persist_off: Log is no longer kept across restarts.
